attempts.action: Inspect the supplied archive, binary, challenge metadata, and scoped service
attempts.result: The archive contains an ELF64 PIE with capture, inspect, merge, erase, and transfer operations; service scope is 145.239.142.129:1339

attempts.action: Disassemble merge_souls, transfer_soul, inspect_soul, and soul_ascension
attempts.result: merge_souls frees the source without clearing archive[source]; transfer_soul mallocs the same 0x40 size and controls callback and essence; inspect_soul calls the callback from +0x38
attempts.notes: Type-1 callback leaks PIE at 0x13a9; soul_ascension is at 0x14fb.

attempts.action: Run the exploit locally with the bundled loader/libc pair
attempts.result: The process aborted with a stack-smashing message before presenting a usable menu
attempts.notes: The bundled runtime pair is unsuitable for local reproduction; direct launch with WSL system glibc works.

attempts.action: Run the complete counter/UAF/callback sequence with the WSL system runtime
attempts.result: The controlled stale slot invoked soul_ascension and returned OWASP{Th4n0s_S0ul_Mem0ry_UAF_Type_Confusion}
attempts.notes: Seven souls captured, slot 0 erased, pairs (1,2), (3,4), and (5,6) merged; transfer reused slot 6's latest freed 0x40 chunk.

attempts.action: Run the deterministic exploit once against the scoped challenge service
attempts.result: The remote service returned the same exact flag after the PIE leak and stale-slot callback
attempts.notes: One remote session was used. Portal remains OPEN; no submission was made.
